Public trust in institutions is eroded when those in power lie or manipulate information.

The public has a right to transparency regarding investigations involving high-level government facilities.
Institutional failures in oversight are more likely when powerful actors are shielded by procedural technicalities.

Social media amplifies irrational behavior and misinformation, contributing to societal decline toward 'idiocracy'.
